svg.aria-label: Push onto a list, on disk. Add one element at the end of a list of 10,000 that merges by position. Each library's own persistence on node:fs, every write awaited. ops/s, log scale, higher is better. Not shown: Yjs (memory only — on disk the Yjs row stores every update already); Loro (memory only — on disk the Loro row appends every update already); TinyBase (no list that merges by position); PouchDB (no list that merges by position); RxDB (Node.js disk storages are Premium); Fireproof (no list that merges by position); GUN (no list that merges by position); OrbitDB (no list that merges by position).
